mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle ( vehicle_id, office_id, vehicle_number, vehicle_model, owner_name, vehicle_type_code, registration_type_code, registration_status_code, registered_at, rejected_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( SEQ_VEHICLE.NEXTVAL, #{officeid}, #{vehiclenumber}, #{vehiclemodel}, #{ownername}, #{vehicletypecode}, #{registrationtypecode}, #{registrationstatuscode}, #{registeredat}, #{rejectedreason}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT v.vehicle_id, v.office_id, o.office_number, v.vehicle_number, v.vehicle_model, v.owner_name, v.vehicle_type_code, v.registration_type_code, v.registration_status_code, v.registered_at, v.rejected_reason, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.deleted_at FROM vehicle v LEFT JOIN office o ON v.office_id = o.office_id WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.vehicle_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle SET vehicle_number = #{vehiclenumber}, vehicle_model = #{vehiclemodel}, owner_name = #{ownername}, vehicle_type_code = #{vehicletypecode}, registration_type_code = #{registrationtypecode}, registration_status_code = #{registrationstatuscode}, rejected_reason = #{rejectedreason}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleid}
